chars.SISTER: a Moroccan young woman about 18, long straight black hair in a high ponytail, wearing an oversized lilac hoodie with a white star print and light grey sweatpants
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman about 48, wearing a mustard yellow headscarf and a dark green long cardigan over a cream blouse, small gold earrings
chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 20, curly black hair, thin moustache, wearing a red and black checked flannel shirt over a white t-shirt and blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Evening dinner at a low round table in a modest Moroccan living room in Meknes, tajine in the middle. MOM sits talking with one hand raised, announcing news; beside her SISTER leans forward mid-reaction, eyes lighting up with a sly excited smile, already scheming. Seen from across the table where the brother sits, head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, warm lamp light, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. MOM in the living room holds a small rolling suitcase and her phone, explaining she must travel for work for ten days; NARRATOR sits on the Moroccan sedari sofa looking up at her surprised, mouth open. Faces visible, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. MOM stands wagging a finger and giving strict advice to her children; NARRATOR and SISTER sit side by side on the sofa nodding obediently, SISTER secretly smiling to herself. Moroccan living room with zellige pattern cushions, faces visible, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. SISTER grabs MOM's arm and asks her sweetly with puppy eyes and clasped hands; MOM smiles and nods, pleased; on the side NARRATOR frowns with his arms crossed, suspicious and annoyed, about to object. Moroccan living room at night, all faces visible, no text.
